entities.summary: Yanick Lahens is a Haitian Francophone writer, novelist, teacher, and lecturer. She became a Prix Femina laureate in 2014. In 2025, the Académie Française awarded her novel Passagères de Nuit the Grand Prix du Roman de l'Académie Française.
